nodes.title: Landauer erasure bound
nodes.summary: Logical irreversibility in the relevant thermodynamic setting carries a minimum erasure cost.

nodes.title: Mass-energy equivalence
nodes.summary: Ordinary energy contributes mass according to relativistic mass-energy equivalence.

nodes.title: Finite Shannon entropy
nodes.summary: H(p) = -sum_i p_i log p_i for a declared finite probability model.

nodes.title: Planck-area cell counting
nodes.summary: A discretised surface model counts information-bearing cells with area scale tied to the Planck area.

nodes.title: Entropic-force relation
nodes.summary: A force is related to an entropy change and displacement under a declared thermodynamic construction.

nodes.title: Dominant-category population dynamics
nodes.summary: A demographic model shifts probability mass toward a dominant language and may permit category extinction.

nodes.title: Stored information bit has finite mass
nodes.source_claim_summary: A stored bit is assigned m_bit = k_B T ln 2 / c^2 and a storage device is predicted to change mass with logical information content.
nodes.reproduction_obligation: The 2019 source derivation and Eq. (6) arithmetic are reproduced in PR #6; the intrinsic stored-bit-energy premise and physical bit-mass interpretation remain unresolved and require controlled empirical discrimination.

nodes.title: Digital information growth produces a future information catastrophe
nodes.source_claim_summary: Growth in bit production is extrapolated to future energy, atom-count and mass thresholds.
nodes.reproduction_obligation: Rebuild the growth model using the corrected comparison values and expose sensitivity to growth-rate assumptions.

nodes.title: Visible-matter particles encode a quantifiable information content
nodes.source_claim_summary: The visible matter of the universe is assigned a bits-per-particle estimate and a total information count.
nodes.reproduction_obligation: Reproduce the particle-count and per-particle information model with all category and probability assumptions.

nodes.title: Annihilation emits additional information-erasure photons
nodes.source_claim_summary: Electron-positron annihilation is predicted to include two additional low-energy photons associated with information erasure.
nodes.reproduction_obligation: Reproduce wavelength, energy and conservation accounting and specify backgrounds and falsifiers.

nodes.title: Windowed m-block entropy spectra detect genome differences
nodes.source_claim_summary: Genome sequences are converted into windowed m-block entropy spectra used to locate mutations.
nodes.reproduction_obligation: Implement the paper's exact windowing, block counting and reference/variant comparison.

nodes.title: Genome mutation dynamics tend to reduce information entropy
nodes.source_claim_summary: The analysed SARS-CoV-2 lineage data are interpreted as a mutation law tending toward lower overall information entropy.
nodes.reproduction_obligation: Separate mutation generation, selection, drift, bottlenecks, phylogeny and sampling before causal promotion.

nodes.title: Second Law of Information Dynamics
nodes.source_claim_summary: Information entropy in the examined information-bearing systems is proposed to remain constant or decrease over time.
nodes.reproduction_obligation: Freeze the state, alphabet, probability, boundary and time-evolution contracts for both published examples.

nodes.title: Cross-domain SLI extension
nodes.source_claim_summary: SLI is extended across digital, genomic, atomic, symmetry and cosmological settings.
nodes.reproduction_obligation: Provide a separate bridge obligation and exact information functional for every target domain.

nodes.title: Infodynamics explains maximum-spin atomic configurations
nodes.source_claim_summary: A binary spin-occupancy entropy ordering is interpreted in relation to Hund-type maximum-spin configurations.
nodes.reproduction_obligation: Separate the binary occupancy identity from an energetic derivation of atomic structure.

nodes.title: Cosmological physical and information entropy compensate
nodes.source_claim_summary: Cosmological thermodynamic reasoning is used to motivate a compensating information-entropy direction; a later paper records a weakness in that route.
nodes.reproduction_obligation: Audit reversible versus irreversible thermodynamic equalities and the definition of the cosmological information term.

nodes.title: Entropy optimisation supports the simulation hypothesis
nodes.source_claim_summary: Compression and computational optimisation are interpreted as evidence compatible with a simulated or computational universe.
nodes.reproduction_obligation: Define discriminating predictions or likelihoods relative to non-simulation explanations.

nodes.title: Newtonian gravity emerges from information dynamics
nodes.source_claim_summary: MEI, SLI, surface cell counting and entropic-force ingredients are combined to recover Newton's inverse-square force.
nodes.reproduction_obligation: Track where G, R^2 scaling, Planck area and displacement assumptions enter and identify any novel prediction.

nodes.title: Equal multiplicities minimise polygon descriptor entropy
nodes.source_claim_summary: The fixed-size multiplicity argument identifies equal multiplicity as a Shannon-entropy minimum.
nodes.reproduction_obligation: Keep fixed-n and variable-n optimisation problems separate from polygon-specific changing descriptor maps.

nodes.title: Language diversity decline conforms to SLI
nodes.source_claim_summary: A dominant/minority language population model yields declining Shannon diversity and is interpreted as an SLI application.
nodes.reproduction_obligation: Determine whether entropy decline adds predictive content beyond the concentration/extinction dynamics already assumed.

nodes.title: Deterministic processing is a restricted monotonic regime
nodes.source_claim_summary: For finite Y=f(X), Shannon entropy satisfies H(Y) <= H(X).
nodes.reproduction_obligation: Do not identify this restricted theorem with the full published SLI until source fidelity is established.

edges.note: The source derivation begins from the erasure-energy scale.
Energy is converted into an assigned mass.
Mass extrapolation depends on the bit-mass proposal.
The particle-information programme extends the information-as-physical premise.
The annihilation prediction depends on information carrying physical energy/mass.
The predicted photon channel uses the particle information estimate.
GENIES uses Shannon-derived block/window statistics.
The mutation-law claim builds on the entropy-spectrum method.
The genome example is one of the motivating systems.
The 2023 paper broadens the proposed law.
Atomic spin occupancy is one cross-domain application.
Cosmology is one cross-domain application.
Compression/minimisation results are interpreted in relation to simulation.
The gravity paper explicitly combines MEI with SLI.
Matter-information estimates inform the physical interpretation.
The proposed entropy direction drives the entropic-force interpretation.
Surface cell counting supplies the spatial scaling.
An entropic-force relation is used.
The gravity result is presented as computational-universe evidence.
Polygon symmetry is a later mathematical-symmetry application.
Language diversity is a later social/demographic application.
The entropy trend is evaluated on an assumed demographic concentration model.
Provides a restricted comparison regime, not a source-faithful reproduction by itself.

rules: A source claim is not adopted as a UFT-ID claim merely by being recorded.
Every UFT-ID assessment uses exactly one canonical claim class.
COUNTEREXAMPLE and PROVED assessments require repository evidence paths unless the node is an external-premise explicitly tagged established-literature.
Dependency edges do not establish truth; they record logical or methodological reliance.
